groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: 🟡 Mixed
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.852% and the 10Y at 5.038%. Brent is +0.16% at about $99.41, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (+12/100, improving ↑). The tension is between supportive options positioning, semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side and elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership on the headwind side.

The important trigger is US10Y at 5.00%. A sustained break above roughly 5.00–5.05% while the 2Y remains near 4.85% would materially weaken the setup, especially if semiconductor leadership also deteriorates. A retreat in the 10Y with continued semiconductor strength would reinforce the positive setup.

consolidationRisk.explanation: Measures short-term upside extension and pullback/consolidation risk, not Nasdaq direction. The 100-point model combines QQQ and SOXX 1D/3D/5D returns, 20DMA/50DMA extension, QQQ RSI14, Nasdaq daily breadth, S5FI, VXN behavior and selective semiconductor/AI Earnings AVWAP extension.
consolidationRisk.note: Higher means more extended/crowded, not more bearish. Missing inputs reduce model coverage rather than being guessed.
